draft.explanation: Starting with an initial portfolio of $80,000 at a monthly interest rate of 0.4% (4.8% nominal annual compounded monthly), the portfolio grows over 120 months alongside monthly contributions of $2,500 for months 1-60, $3,500 for months 61-120, and a one-time withdrawal of $20,000 at month 90. The projected month-120 balance is $558,563.98. Compared to the target of $750,000, there is a shortfall of $191,436.02. To cover this gap over 120 months, an additional end-of-month contribution of $1,245.55 (exact: $1,245.5464) per month is required.

revision.explanation:
Re-evaluating the portfolio cash flows at a 0.4% monthly rate over 120 months:
1. Initial $80,000 grows to $129,182.18 at month 120.
2. Months 1-60 contributions ($2,500/month end-of-month) grow to $169,211.77 at month 60, and then to $215,023.94 at month 120.
3. Months 61-120 contributions ($3,500/month end-of-month) grow to $236,896.48 at month 120.
4. The $20,000 withdrawal at month 90 end-of-month reduces the month-120 balance by $22,545.44.

Summing these yields a projected month-120 balance of $558,557.16. Compared to the $750,000 target, the shortfall is $191,442.84. Dividing this shortfall by the 120-month end-of-month annuity factor of 153.6943 gives an exact additional monthly contribution of $1,245.6079, which rounds upward to $1,245.61 per month.
